in_sanskrit.name: Lekhram
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Scriptures
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lekhram एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Lekhram is derived from Sanskrit, where 'Lekh' means 'writing' or 'scripture' and 'Ram' is the name of Lord Vishnu. Lekhram is considered a name for boys in Hindu tradition, symbolizing wisdom and divine knowledge.
